description: This file implements a login page component for a web application, handling user authentication through a two-step process: first fetching user organizations based on email, then submitting login credentials. It manages UI states, handles API calls, and performs navigation upon success or failure.

methods.name: handleFetchOrgs
methods.description: Handles fetching user organizations based on email input, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles user login process, including validation, API call, and navigation.
